helpIntro: Find answers about settings, offers and affiliate links.
helpSettingsBody: Open Settings from the pikvia popup to pause the extension, control automatic links or change your language. The suggestions switch stays at the bottom of the main popup.
helpOffersBody: Open Codes & offers, choose a service and check its current offers. Copy a code to enter at checkout, or open the offer link. Only verified promotions show a discount percentage. Final eligibility and price are set by the service.
helpPrivacyBody: Preferences stay on your device. Offer lookups use our Cloudflare Worker. We do not store your browsing history. See the privacy policy for details.
helpTroubleBody: Check Settings, browser site access and the service's offer conditions. Contact us with your browser, extension version and the problem. Do not send passwords, cookies or complete affiliate URLs.
